Case reference: 2007004499.CaseDesc: Rod Pavan was last heard from on August 10, 2007. Rod advised his landlord that he was moving to British Columbia that day. His vehicle was later found near Shannon Lake Road, north of Val Cote, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014003868.CaseDesc: On Sunday April 18, 1976, Gary Michael Pinkney left his home in Fort Churchill, Manitoba, at around midday, riding his snowmobile. His destination was Hudson Bay, and he had planned to return home that same evening. The following day, April 19, at approximately 8:00 am, Helen Pinkney contacted the Churchill RCMP detachment to report that her husband had not yet returned home. Extensive land and air searches of the area were conducted over several days, but were unsuccessful. Given his intended route, it is presumed that Gary drowned, and his remains have not been located.

Boots: Leather, Beige, Felt-lined with white fur trim
Jewelry: Gold, Gold ring with black stone
Scar: 4 inch scar on either left or right leg
Tattoo: Right Forearm, Text on a scroll "Gary"
Right Forearm, Eagle with rising sun

Case reference: 2011002999.CaseDesc: Donald Pringle was last seen on August 28, 2010. Donald takes medication and when he is not on his medication he becomes agitated and aggressive and makes poor decisions. Donald last had his medication on August 27. All family and friends have been interviewed and no one has seen or heard from Donald. He was last seen walking on Great Northern Road by Second Line East on August 28, 2010 at 2 pm.  At the time Donald was not carrying anything with him and was alone.

Case reference: 2020007336.CaseDesc: On December 16, 1970, Abraham Wolfson was seen for the last time leaving a law office in Toronto, Ontario. Abraham had left with certificates worth $50,000 and had come into the city to arrange the sale of a property. Despite the offer of a reward from Abraham’s family, there has been no information pertaining to his whereabouts.
